blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recently, pixel diffusion models ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) advance text-to-image generation by modeling images end-to-end in RGB, avoiding the reconstruction ceiling and decoding artifacts of a VAE.
However, recent pixel diffusion still requires many sequential denoiser evaluations, making generation slow and costly.
Few-step distillation, represented by distribution matching distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) , is the standard remedy: it uses a learned fake score to optimize a distribution-matching objective toward teacher outputs, instead of regressing the sampling trajectory step by step, which compounds error as steps are removed ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) .
DMD is general, but its modern text-to-image recipe has been developed primarily around latent diffusion. Direct RGB generation changes both supervision interfaces: fine texture is explicit during teacher matching, while clean outputs expose pretrained visual representations for real-data guidance.
blocks.zh:
最近,像素传播模型(Yu et al.,2026;Ma et al.,2026)通过在RGB中建模图像端到端来推进文本到图像生成,避免了VAE的重建天花板和解码文物.
然而,最近的像素扩散仍然需要许多相继的denoiser评价,使得生成速度缓慢,成本高昂.
很少分级蒸馏,以分布匹配蒸馏(DMD)为代表(Yin等人,2024b); Yin等人,2024a ),是标准补救方法:它用一个学得的假分来优化向教师输出的分布比对目标,而不是一步一步地递减采样轨迹,从而将错误作为步骤去除(Luo等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年)。
DMD是泛泛的,但其现代文字对图像的配方主要是围绕潜在传播而开发的. 直接RGB生成会改变两个监督界面:在师资比对时精细的纹理是明确的,而清洁输出则会暴露为真实数据指导而预先训练的视觉表现.

blocks.en:
We analyze how the general DMD recipe interacts with native RGB. For teacher matching, the standard recipe samples matching levels broadly, without accounting for how information is represented in uncompressed RGB. Low-noise inputs already determine coarse image content, so teacher–critic differences can be dominated by fine texture rather than the distributional factors DMD should transfer. Our diagnostics indicate that higher-noise matching is more consistent with structural supervision.
For real-data guidance, DMD2 adds a GAN loss against real images ( Yin et al., 2024a ) . Its conventional Feature-GAN design attaches the adversarial head to the 560 560 M fake-score network. For a native-RGB student, this coupling is avoidable: clean outputs allow guidance through a pretrained visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the fake-score critic.
blocks.zh:
我们分析一般的DMD食谱如何与本地RGB互动. 对于师资匹配,标准食谱样本大致匹配等级,不考虑信息如何在未压缩的RGB中表示. 低噪音输入已经决定了粗糙的图像内容,因此教师-批评差异可以被精细的纹理支配,而不是分配因素DMD应该转移. 我们的诊断表明,高噪音匹配 更符合结构监督。
对于真实数据指导,DMD2相对于真实图像增加了GAN损失(Yin等人,2024a). 其传统的特性-GAN设计将对抗性头部附在560,560M假积分网上. 对于本地-RGB的学生来说,这种耦合是可避免的:干净的输出允许通过预先训练的视觉表现来进行引导,而不翻转解码器或分享假分评人.

blocks.en:
Motivated by this evidence, we design DMA 2 , which specializes the teacher-matching and real-data-guidance interfaces of DMD for native-RGB generation.
On the teacher-matching side, frequency controls, gradient visualizations, and a targeted matching-band intervention provide converging evidence for a near-clean local-texture bias in native-RGB matching (Section 3.1 ). These diagnostics motivate a fixed high-noise matching band that improves the model’s performance without additional trainable modules or online scheduling.
On the real-data side, we exploit direct access to clean RGB through a dual-granularity, critic-decoupled guidance design. DINO-Adv removes the fake-score critic from the adversarial gradient path and uses an 86 86 M-parameter frozen DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) encoder with only 1.58 1.58 M learnable parameters in its heads, reducing same-pipeline step time from 1.82 1.82 to 0.72 0.72 seconds ( 2.5 × 2.5\times faster). This local adversary, however, does not define how each generated sample should move relative to the empirical real and generated distributions in semantic feature space. We therefore introduce Anchor-Field Loss (AF-Loss), a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. AF-Loss acts alongside the prompt-conditioned teacher objective, maintains detached rolling supports across minibatches, and shares the frozen DINOv2 encoder with DINO-Adv. It complements local adversarial guidance without adding learnable parameters or inference-time computation. With both sides addressed, the four-step student performs better than the 25-step DeCo ( Ma et al., 2026 ) teacher and existing few-step distillers on all reported metrics; the same recipe transfers to a second backbone (PixelGen-XXL; Appendix B ).
The main contributions of this work are: • We propose DMA 2 , a few-step native-RGB DMD framework that specializes both teacher matching and real-data guidance for pixel-space generation. Across DPG-Bench, GenEval, VQAScore, and COCO30K, its four-step student ranks first among the evaluated few-step distillers and performs better than the 25 25 -step teacher on all seven reported metrics; the same recipe transfers to a second pixel-space backbone. • We specialize both sides of the general DMD recipe for native RGB. On the teacher-matching side, converging diagnostics provide evidence for a near-clean local-texture shortcut and motivate DM-Band , which improves both alignment and image quality. On the real-data side, direct RGB access enables DINO-Adv to decouple local adversarial guidance from the 560 560 M learnable fake-score critic, using an 86 86 M-parameter frozen DINOv2 backbone and only 1.58 1.58 M learnable head parameters, while reducing same-pipeline step time from 1.82 1.82 to 0.72 0.72 seconds. • We introduce AF-Loss , a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. It supplies distribution-level guidance from detached rolling supports while preserving prompt-conditioned teacher supervision, shares the frozen DINOv2 encoder with DINO-Adv, and adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A line of work generates in RGB without a frozen VAE, from cascaded pixel models ( Saharia et al., 2022 ) to end-to-end RGB transformers competitive with latent models ( Jabri et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2025 ; Crowson et al., 2024 ) . PixelDiT scales dual-level pixel transformers to megapixel generation ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , whereas PiD uses conditional pixel diffusion for latent decoding and upsampling ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . The paradigm also extends to controllable generation, restoration, depth and geometry, and 3D ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . Our teacher DeCo ( Ma et al., 2026 ) is a frequency-decoupled member of this family. This literature primarily studies the training of native-RGB text-to-image models; few-step distillation tailored to their representation characteristics remains comparatively underexplored.
blocks.zh: 从级联像素模型(Saharia等人,2022年)到具有潜在模型竞争力的端到端的RGB变压器(Jabri等人,2023年;Hoogeboom等人,2023年;Hoogeboom等人,2025年;Crowson等人,2024年)在RGB中生成一行不冷冻VAE. PixelDiT将双级像素变压器比例化为兆像素生成(Yu等人,2026年),而PiD则使用有条件的像素扩散来进行潜伏的解码和上标(Lu等人,2026年). 该范式还延伸至可控生成,恢复,深度和几何,以及3D(Lin等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年;徐等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年a;袁等人,2026年;徐等人,2026年;Gao等人,2026年). 我们的老师DeCo(马等人,2026年)是这个家族中一个频繁脱钩的成员. 这些文献主要研究本土-RGB文本到图像模型的培训;很少针对其代表特征的分步蒸馏仍然相对未得到充分的探索.

blocks.en: Distribution matching distillation trains a few-step student to match a teacher’s output distribution through a learned fake score ( Yin et al., 2024b ) , and DMD2 adds a real-image GAN term with two-time-scale updates for stability ( Yin et al., 2024a ) . Recent baselines Flash, TDM, Decoupled DMD, and DMDR span general acceleration, trajectory matching, CFG–DMD decoupling, and RL post-training, respectively ( Chadebec et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Related score and variational objectives distill in one step ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Nguyen and Tran, 2024 ) , while consistency and rectified-flow methods regress the sampling trajectory ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Modern text-to-image distillation has centered on latent teachers; we specialize DMD’s matching noise and real-data guidance for native RGB.
blocks.zh: 发行匹配蒸馏训练几个步骤的学生通过学习的假分(Yin等人,2024b)来匹配教师的输出分配,DMD2增加了一个真实的图像GAN术语,并加了两度更新的稳定性(Yin等人,2024a). 最近的基线Flash、TDM、Deconupled DMD和DMDR分别跨越一般加速、轨迹匹配、CFG-DMD脱钩和RL培训后(Chadebec等人,2025年;Luo等人,2025年;Liu等人,2026年b;Jiang等人,2026年) 相关得分和变异目标在一步中蒸馏(周等人,2024年;阮和Tran,2024年),而一致性和修正流法则使采样轨迹倒退(罗等人,2023年;刘等人,2024年). 现代文字到图像蒸馏以潜在教师为中心;我们专门研究DMD的匹配噪声和本地RGB的真实数据指导。

blocks.en: Frozen encoders support projected/DINOv2 discriminators ( Sauer et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ) , representation alignment ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , and distributional objectives based on feature statistics or attract–repel fields ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Deng et al., 2026 ) . Drifting Models use a kernelized field as the standalone objective for class-conditional generation ( Deng et al., 2026 ) . AF-Loss is designed as an auxiliary objective for text-to-image DMD: prompt-conditioned teacher supervision remains active, detached rolling supports extend beyond the current minibatch, and the DINOv2 encoder is shared with DINO-Adv.

blocks.en: 3.2 Critic-decoupled local adversary (DINO-Adv)
blocks.zh: 3.2 批评与脱钩的当地对手(DINO-Adv)

blocks.en:
Matching the teacher alone is limited by its imperfect score on real data ( Yin et al., 2024a ) , so we add guidance that learns from real images directly. We exploit a design freedom exposed by native RGB outputs: because the student emits clean RGB natively, real-data guidance can be evaluated directly by an external pretrained model without traversing a VAE decoder or sharing the fake-score critic. DINO-Adv decouples the adversarial gradient path from the co-adapting fake-score critic with 560 560 M learnable parameters and instead uses an 86 86 M-parameter frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14 backbone with only 1.58 1.58 M learnable head parameters, reducing per-step training time from 1.82 1.82 to 0.72 0.72 seconds ( 2.5 × 2.5\times faster) while supplying a stable local realism signal.

blocks.en: DINO-Adv supplies local parametric patch guidance, but its patch decisions do not specify a distribution-level direction in semantic feature space. A complementary objective for DMD should provide such a direction without replacing the conditional teacher objective, learning another estimator, or modifying inference. We therefore introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free semantic distribution anchor-field loss for DMD . It turns detached empirical real and generated feature supports into a sample-dependent, multi-scale displacement and injects that displacement as a stopped target for the generator. This is distinct from direct feature regression, whose target does not depend on the geometry of both empirical supports, and from standalone field-based generation ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , where the field itself defines the generative process.
blocks.zh: DINO-Adv提供局部参数补丁指导,但其补丁决定并没有在语义特征空间中指定分布级方向. DMD的一个互补目标应提供这样一个方向,而不取代有条件的教师目标,学习另一个估计者,或修改推论. 因此,我们引入了AF-Loss,这是DMD的无参数语义分布锚地损失. 它将分离的经验性真实和生成的特性支持转化为一个依赖样本的、多规模的流离失所,并将这种流离失所作为生成者的停止目标。 这与直接特征回归不同,其目标并不取决于两种经验支持的几何学,也与独立基于场的生成(Deng et al., 2026)不同,其中领域本身定义了基因过程.

blocks.en: Concretely, AF-Loss operates on normalized final-layer DINOv2 CLS features extracted directly from generated RGB. Multi-scale kernels attract each generated feature toward real-feature neighborhoods and repel it from generated-feature neighborhoods. DMD continues to provide teacher and prompt guidance, while AF-Loss reuses the same frozen encoder as DINO-Adv and adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation. For a stable empirical support, current real and student features are prepended to two detached FIFO banks B r B_{r} and B f B_{f} , each capped at 256 256 features; the sole trainable path is z → x ^ → G θ z\!\to\!\hat{x}\!\to\!G_{\theta} (Figure 5 ).

blocks.en:
We distill a 1.1B-parameter, 25-step DeCo teacher ( Ma et al., 2026 ) at 512 × 512 512\times 512 resolution. The student is initialized from the teacher and trained for 20k optimizer steps on eight GPUs with batch size 32. Optimization uses AdamW without weight decay, at learning rates 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} (generator), 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} (fake-score network), and 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} (adversarial heads), with the fake-score network updated five times per generator step; classifier-free guidance is 4.0.
The canonical DMA 2 student combines the fixed high-noise band U ⁡ ( .02 , .35 ) U(.02,.35) with dual-granularity real-data guidance over one frozen DINOv2 encoder: local parametric DINO-Adv at weight 0.01 0.01 and parameter-free semantic distribution-field AF-Loss at weight 0.05 0.05 , using radii { .02 , .05 , .2 } \{.02,.05,.2\} and 256-token real/generated banks. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented DMA 2 , which specializes DMD’s teacher matching and real-data guidance for native-RGB generation. Converging diagnostics identify a near-clean local-texture bias that motivates DM-Band. Native RGB then enables direct external supervision: DINO-Adv decouples local patch guidance from the fake-score critic, while AF-Loss adds parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field guidance, operating on detached rolling supports alongside prompt-conditioned teacher supervision with no learned estimator or inference-time cost. Across four benchmarks, the four-step student exceeds its teacher on all seven metrics and ranks first among the evaluated distillers.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了DMA 2, 专为DMD的老师配对和真实数据指导, 汇合诊断发现一种接近清洁的局部纹理偏差,激发DM-Band. 本地 RGB 允许直接外部监管 : DINO-Adv从假分评人处解析本地补丁指导,而AF-Loss则添加了参数无辅助语义分布-场指导,运行在脱落的滚动支持上,同时进行快速有条件的教师监督,没有学习的估测器或推论时间成本. 在四个基准中,四步学生在所有7个指标上都超过了教师,在评估的蒸馏器中排名第一。

blocks.en: Training uses eight data-parallel ranks, per-rank batch size 4, and 20k optimizer steps. The generator, fake-score network, and DINOv2 heads use separate optimizers. DMD2’s feature-GAN back-propagates its discriminator through the 560 560 M critic, whereas DINO-Adv attaches a 1.58 1.58 M head to a frozen 86 86 M DINOv2. blocks.en: To test whether the gain comes simply from applying a frozen-DINOv2 penalty, and whether any distribution-matching objective in the same space would do, we compare AF-Loss against two alternatives on the identical normalized last-layer CLS features, encoder, four-step protocol, and loss weight ( .05 .05 ): (i) direct perceptual matching (regression to real CLS features), and (ii) a matched multi-scale DINOv2-CLS MMD that pulls the generated feature distribution toward the same 256 256 -feature real bank with the same kernel bandwidths, differing from AF-Loss only in that it minimizes a batch-level distribution distance rather than injecting a sample-dependent attract–repel displacement. All rows use the AF-Loss-only ablation setting in Table 2 : DM-Band and DINO-Adv are disabled, and only the feature-space objective is changed. All three add no learnable parameters. Table 6 shows AF-Loss is best on five of the seven metrics; direct regression attains the highest GenEval and MMD the highest recall. Against the stronger MMD baseline it raises DPG by 1.317 1.317 ( 83.194 83.194 vs 81.877 81.877 ), IS by 3.69 3.69 , VQA by 0.0130 0.0130 , and CLIP by 0.0040 0.0040 , approximately matches it on GenEval ( 0.8090 0.8090 vs 0.8077 0.8077 ), and lowers NIQE by 0.859 0.859 ; MMD attains slightly higher recall ( 0.3330 0.3330 vs 0.3161 0.3161 ), indicating marginally broader coverage at the cost of alignment and quality. Direct regression gives higher GenEval but is worse on the other six metrics. The gains therefore do not arise from introducing DINOv2 features, nor from distribution matching per se; they depend on the specific sample-dependent attract–repel field.
blocks.zh: 为了测试收益是否只是来自适用冻结的DINOv2惩罚,以及是否在同一空间中实现任何分配匹配目标,我们比较AF-Loss与相同常态的最后一层CLS特性,编码器,四步协议和减重(0.05.05)上的两个替代品: (一)直接感知匹配(回归到真实的CLS特性), (二)匹配的多尺度DINov2-CLS MMD将生成的特性分布拉向相同的256 256 — feature real bank, 具有相同的内核带宽,这与AF-Loss不同之处在于它只是最小化了批量的分布距离,而不是插入一个依赖样本的吸引-repel 迁移。 所有行都使用表2中的AF-Loss-唯一ablation设置:DM-Band和DINO-Adv被禁用,只有特性-空间目标被更改. 三者皆加无学之参数. 表6显示,AF-Loss最擅长于7个衡量标准中的5个;直接回归达到最高的GenEval,MMD达到最高的召回。 与较强的MMD基线相比,DPG增加了1.317个(83.194个83.194个对81.877个),IS增加了3.69个3.69个,VQA增加了0.0130个0.0130个,CLIP增加了0.0040个0.0040个),与GenEval(0.8090个0.8090个对0.8077个0.8077个)相匹配,将NIQE减少了0.859个0.859个;MMD得到的召回略高(0.3330个0.3330个对0.3161个0.3161个),表明以调整和质量为代价的覆盖面略为扩大。 直接回归给出了更高的GenEval,但在其他6个度量标准上更为糟糕. 因此,收益并不来自引进DINOv2特性,也不来自分配匹配本身;它们取决于具体的样本吸引-检索领域。

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制

blocks.en: Two limitations remain. First, DINO-Adv and AF-Loss inherit the inductive biases of the frozen DINOv2 representation. Although its multi-layer patch features and final-layer CLS feature provide complementary local and semantic guidance, they may not fully capture text-conditioned spatial relations or domain-specific visual attributes. Second, our evaluation emphasizes established automated benchmarks and qualitative comparisons; broader human-preference, fairness, and safety evaluations remain future work.
blocks.zh: 仍然有两个限制。 首先,DINO-Adv和AF-Loss继承了被冻结的DINOv2代表的诱导偏差. 虽然它的多层补丁特征和最终层的CLS特征提供了互补的局部和语义指导,但它们可能无法完全捕捉文本条件化的空间关系或特定域的视觉属性. 第二,我们的评价强调既定的自动化基准和定性比较;更广泛的人优待、公平和安全评价仍然是今后的工作。
